subscription.payment_status_cancelled: You cancelled this payment. No charge was made. You can try again.

accounting.guide_overview_step_1: Review this month's figures and spot values that need attention.
accounting.guide_overview_step_2: Use the shortcuts to explore receivables, VAT, or banking.
accounting.guide_overview_result: A quick view of financial health before reviewing detail.
accounting.guide_profit_help: Sales less product cost; it does not yet include every operating expense.
accounting.guide_vat_help: The difference between VAT collected on sales and deductible VAT on purchases.
accounting.guide_chart_title: The structure behind your journal entries
accounting.guide_chart_step_1: Review the accounts Ohnix creates automatically.
accounting.guide_chart_step_2: Add an account only when you need to separate a specific concept.
accounting.guide_chart_step_3: Open an account ledger to understand where its balance comes from.
accounting.guide_chart_result: A consistent catalog that classifies movements and feeds reports.
accounting.guide_chart_type_help: Identifies whether an account is an asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense, or cost.
accounting.guide_ledger_help: Shows every debit and credit for an account and its running balance.
accounting.guide_journal_title: The complete history of every movement
accounting.guide_journal_step_1: Choose a period and optionally filter by the process that created the entry.
accounting.guide_journal_step_2: Expand an entry to inspect affected accounts and verify double entry.
accounting.guide_journal_result: Traceability from the original operation to its debits and credits.
accounting.guide_debit_help: The left side of an entry. Its effect depends on the account type.
accounting.guide_credit_help: The right side of an entry. Every entry must have equal debits and credits.
accounting.guide_voucher_step_1: Create a draft with a date, explanation, and at least two lines.
accounting.guide_voucher_step_2: Confirm that debits and credits are equal.
accounting.guide_voucher_step_3: Post after review; afterwards it can only be voided with a reversal.
accounting.guide_voucher_result: An auditable adjustment included in ledgers and financial statements.
accounting.guide_draft_help: Editable and has no effect on balances or reports yet.
accounting.guide_posted_help: Already affects accounting and is protected from direct editing.
accounting.guide_third_parties_title: Balances explained by customer or supplier
accounting.guide_third_step_1: Filter the period and third-party type you want to review.
accounting.guide_third_step_2: Open a party to see every movement and its running balance.
accounting.guide_third_result: A subsidiary ledger showing who owes, whom you owe, and what forms the balance.
accounting.guide_opening_help: Balance carried into the selected range.
accounting.guide_closing_help: Opening balance plus all movements inside the range.
accounting.guide_trial_title: The check that your books balance
accounting.guide_trial_step_1: Select the period you want to review.
accounting.guide_trial_step_2: Confirm total debits equal total credits.
accounting.guide_trial_result: A control view by account with opening, movement, and closing balances.
accounting.guide_period_step_1: First review the trial balance and financial statements for the month.
accounting.guide_period_step_2: Close the period to block new entries dated in that month.
accounting.guide_period_step_3: For a correction, reopen it temporarily and record a reason.
accounting.guide_period_result: Protected months with a clear close and reopening audit trail.
accounting.guide_close_help: Blocks new postings in the month and transfers its result to equity.
accounting.guide_reopen_help: Allows corrections for a limited time and records who did it and why.
accounting.guide_statements_title: Turn journal entries into financial information
accounting.guide_statements_summary: Review performance for a period and accumulated financial position as of a date.
accounting.guide_statements_step_1: Use the income statement to analyze revenue, costs, and margin.
accounting.guide_statements_step_2: Use the balance sheet to review assets, liabilities, and equity.
accounting.guide_statements_result: Financial reports calculated directly from the accounting ledger.
accounting.guide_income_help: Explains whether operations produced profit or loss during a date range.
accounting.guide_balance_help: Shows what you own, owe, and accumulated equity as of a date.
accounting.guide_taxes_step_1: Confirm the company's general tax status.
accounting.guide_taxes_step_2: Create concepts with validated rates, bases, effective dates, and tax accounts.
accounting.guide_taxes_step_3: Select only the withholdings that truly apply to each purchase.
accounting.guide_taxes_result: VAT and withholdings frozen per document and posted automatically.
accounting.guide_tax_vat_help: Sales and purchase tax calculated from the product's frozen tax treatment.
accounting.guide_withholding_help: Amount deducted from a supplier and recorded as the company's tax liability.
accounting.empty_chart_help: Accounts that classify your movements will appear here. Ohnix creates the main ones automatically; add another only when you need more detail.
accounting.empty_third_help: Customers and suppliers appear after a sale, purchase, payment, or return moves their control account.
accounting.empty_vouchers_help: Use them for adjustments and reclassifications that do not originate from automatic sales, purchases, or payments.
accounting.empty_journal_help: Try another range or record an operation. Sales, purchases, payments, returns, and posted vouchers appear here automatically.
accounting.empty_periods_help: Ohnix creates each monthly period with its first journal entry. You do not need to open it manually.
accounting.quick_start_chart_help: See where every movement will be classified.
accounting.quick_start_operation_help: A completed purchase or sale creates the entry.
accounting.quick_start_journal_help: Open the journal and follow the double entry.
accounting.new_account_guidance: Create an account only when existing accounts do not represent the concept you need. Code and type determine how it appears in ledgers and statements.
accounting.new_account_code_hint: Use numbering consistent with your current catalog; codes cannot be duplicated.
accounting.new_account_type_hint: The type controls which statement includes the account and how its balance is interpreted.
accounting.voucher_editor_guidance: Use this voucher for accounting adjustments, not to replace sales, purchases, or payments. Write an explanation another person can audit later.
accounting.voucher_support_hint: Optional HTTPS link to supporting evidence, such as a document or external receipt.
accounting.voucher_third_party_guidance: When using Customers (1305) or Suppliers (2205), identify the third party on that line so the subsidiary ledger keeps the correct person or company balance.
accounting.reopen_period_guidance: Reopening allows new entries for the selected time. When closed again, Ohnix recalculates the period result transfer.
accounting.withholding_type_hint: Defines the tax obligation represented by the concept.
accounting.withholding_base_hint: The value to which Ohnix applies the rate.
accounting.withholding_rate_hint: Enter a percentage, for example 2.5 for a 2.5% rate.
accounting.withholding_minimum_hint: If the purchase base is lower, the concept is recorded but withholds no amount.
accounting.withholding_account_hint: Liability account credited with the withheld amount.
accounting.page_subtitle: Browse the chart of accounts, the journal, and manage accounting periods.
accounting.onboarding_new_body: The chart of accounts was created automatically. Nothing else to do — every sale and purchase you complete will post itself to the journal, and the Balance Sheet and Income Statement will update as you go.
accounting.onboarding_backfilled_title: Your accounting history is now complete
accounting.onboarding_backfilled_body: We automatically generated journal entries for your sales and purchases from before this module existed, so the journal and reports reflect your whole business, not just from now on. Those entries are marked "[Histórico]".
accounting.tab_chart_of_accounts_caption: Organizes your accounts by type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, cost, expense). Ohnix created the base chart automatically and uses it to classify every sale, purchase, and payment - you usually won't need to touch it, but you can add your own accounts if your accountant asks for one.
accounting.tab_third_parties_caption: Review debits, credits, and accumulated balances by customer, supplier, or other third party, preserving the name and document recorded when posted.
accounting.tab_vouchers_caption: Create accounting adjustments and reclassifications. Drafts do not affect financial statements; once posted they are immutable and can only be voided with a reversing entry.
accounting.voucher_post_confirm: Post this voucher? It cannot be edited afterwards.
accounting.voucher_void_reason_required: A reason for voiding is required.
accounting.voucher_balanced: The voucher is balanced and ready to post.
accounting.voucher_unbalanced: Debits and credits must match before posting.
accounting.tab_journal_caption: Every automatic operation and posted voucher appears here, split into Debit and Credit. Both sides always match and posted entries are never edited.
accounting.tab_periods_caption: Periods group your accounting by month. Closing a period stops new entries from being added to or changed in a month you've already reviewed and signed off on - it's optional, it doesn't block your operation if you skip it.
accounting.gross_margin_disclaimer: This report doesn't include operating expenses (rent, payroll, etc.) since Ohnix doesn't post those automatically yet - it's a gross margin, not a full net income statement.
accounting.current_earnings_row_hint: Calculated automatically: revenue minus costs and expenses for the period. Not a real ledger account, which is why it has no code.
accounting.not_balanced_warning: The balance sheet doesn't balance - this should never happen. Please report it.
accounting.account_type_expense_hint: Costs of running the business, not tied directly to a sale (rent, payroll, utilities).
accounting.account_type_cost_hint: What it costs you to produce or buy what you sell (cost of goods sold).
accounting.no_chart_accounts: The chart of accounts hasn't been generated yet.
accounting.no_entries: No journal entries in this date range.
accounting.close_period_confirm_content: A closing entry will move the month's result into "Utilidades acumuladas" (retained earnings), and no new entries will be allowed to post into this period. Close it once you've reviewed the month's numbers and confirmed they're correct.
accounting.reopen_period_reason_required: A reason for reopening is required.
accounting.tab_overview_caption: A quick look at this month's numbers, plus shortcuts to the related tools (receivables/payables, VAT, bank reconciliation) that live in other modules.
accounting.overview_link_cartera_desc: Outstanding balances by customer and supplier — computed in Reports from your orders and purchases, not here.
accounting.overview_link_vat_desc: VAT collected and credited by rate and period, ready for your bimonthly filing — in Reports.
accounting.overview_link_reconciliation_desc: Match your movements against the bank statement — done from Finance, one account at a time.
accounting.ledger_empty: No movements in this date range.
accounting.tab_taxes_caption: Ohnix tax center: configure responsibilities, manage effective-dated concepts, and control how VAT and withholdings flow into journal entries and payables.
accounting.taxes_vat_desc: Every sale and purchase already calculates VAT based on the product's tax treatment and posts it to the "VAT generated" and "VAT deductible" accounts. The breakdown by rate and period, ready for your filing, is in the VAT report.
accounting.taxes_retefuente_desc: Automatically calculating and recording income tax withholding on your purchases and supplier payments (by concept, rate, and minimum base in UVT). Not available yet — Ohnix doesn't withhold or issue withholding certificates today.
accounting.taxes_reteica_desc: The ReteICA rate depends on the municipality and your economic activity code (CIIU) — it isn't one national rate. We're designing how to configure this per company before automating it.
accounting.taxes_renta_desc: You (or your accountant) file your income tax return directly with DIAN — Ohnix doesn't file it for you. What we will do is get the accounting information you already generate here (sales, costs, VAT, withholdings) ready in a format you can hand your accountant instead of building it by hand.
accounting.taxes_professional_review_notice: Tax configuration (who's a withholding agent, applicable rates, VAT responsibility) depends on your company's specific situation. Review it with your accountant before treating it as final.
accounting.taxes_withholding_config_desc: Define your company's general tax status. Applicable concepts are selected explicitly on each purchase and Ohnix freezes the calculation to preserve history.
accounting.withholding_concepts_desc: Effective-dated concepts with a minimum base, rate, and tax account. When selected on a purchase, Ohnix calculates net payable and posts the double entry automatically.
accounting.withholding_empty: No concepts yet. Create the first one using the rate confirmed by your accountant.
accounting.withholding_immutable_notice: Versions are not edited, protecting historical purchases. When a rate changes, close the previous effective period and create a new version.
accounting.taxes_is_withholding_agent_label: Is your company a withholding agent (agente retenedor)?
accounting.taxes_is_withholding_agent_hint: Determines whether your company is required to withhold and file income-tax withholding when paying suppliers. Confirm with your accountant if you're not sure.
accounting.taxes_ica_municipality_hint: 5-digit code for the municipality where your company carries out its economic activity, e.g. 11001 for Bogotá.
accounting.taxes_ica_activity_hint: 4-digit code for your main economic activity under the CIIU classification.
accounting.taxes_ica_rate_hint: The rate is set by your municipality's own agreement for your activity — there's no single national rate. Ask your accountant or check with your municipality's tax office.
accounting.withholding_report_heading: From purchase to current withholding, fully traceable
accounting.withholding_report_desc: Review withholding on completed purchases, amounts reversed by returns, and the current net value. Pending purchases are excluded.
accounting.withholding_report_empty_desc: Completed purchase withholdings will appear here. Expand the dates or apply a concept when recording a purchase.
accounting.withholding_certificate_generated: Generated from the accounting audit trail
accounting.withholding_certificate_notice: This document summarizes information recorded in Ohnix. Review company details and tax validity with your accountant before delivering it.
accounting.new_account_parent_hint: Groups this account under an existing one, if your chart of accounts uses a hierarchy. You can leave this blank.
accounting.activate_account_confirm: Activate this account? It will be available for new entries again.
accounting.deactivate_account_confirm: Deactivate this account? No new entries can post to it, but its history is kept.
accounting.tab_trial_balance_caption: Every ledger account with its opening balance, this period's movement, and closing balance - useful for checking everything ties out before closing the month.
accounting.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

team.roles_description: Define what each role can see or edit, module by module.

team.role_owner_locked: The Owner role can't be edited

team.shared_role_warning: {{count}} members share this role. Saving here changes access for all of them, not just one.
team.fork_notice: {{count}} other member(s) also have this role. Saving will create an independent copy just for {{name}} — no one else will be affected.

team.billing_locked_title: You don't have access to billing

team.transfer_ownership_description: Make another member the owner. You'll become a regular member.
team.transfer_ownership_confirm_content: You'll lose full control of the team immediately. This can't be undone from here.
team.company_branding_hint: Your logo and company info show up on order PDFs from the Business plan up. Brand color and footer text, from the Scale plan.
team.company_footer_text_hint: Shown at the bottom of order PDFs - terms, a thank-you note, etc.
team.company_footer_text_placeholder: E.g. 30-day warranty on all our products.
team.company_accent_color_hint: Replaces the default accent color on order PDFs.
team.owner_only_action: Only the team owner can do this.
team.your_role_description: This is what you can see or edit in the team's account.
team.accept_success: You're in! Welcome to the team.
team.accept_expired: This invitation expired. Ask for a new one to be sent.
team.seat_limit_reached: Your plan's seat limit has been reached.
team.email_already_exists: That email already has an Ohnix account.
team.session_replaced: You were signed out of this device because you signed in somewhere else.
team.scope_none: No access to any point of sale
team.edit_scope_description: Choose which points of sale this member can access. The owner always has access to all of them.
team.edit_scope_all_option: All points of sale (including ones created later)
team.edit_scope_select_placeholder: Choose one or more points of sale

pointOfSale.deactivate_default_blocked: The main point of sale can't be deactivated.
pointOfSale.limit_reached: You reached your plan's points of sale limit.

pointOfSale.move_select_placeholder: Choose the destination point of sale

admin.title: Platform administration
admin.description: Manage companies and users across the full Ohnix platform.
admin.only_admin: Only the Ohnix main admin can access this section.
admin.companies_description: Create and maintain the companies managed inside Ohnix.

inventory_tour.dismiss_confirm_desc: You already created some practice records. If you leave them and pick the tour back up later, you could end up with duplicates. Delete them now, or leave them as they are?
inventory_tour.finish_desc: You just walked through your first complete flow: created a product, bought it from a supplier, sold it to a customer, and watched stock move at every step. Everything here was practice - it never touched your real inventory. What do you want to do with it?
inventory_tour.step_welcome_desc: I'll guide you through creating your first real flow, step by step, like it's day one. We'll build some practice data together - none of this touches your real inventory, and at the end you decide whether to keep it or delete it in one click.
inventory_tour.step_plan_desc: We'll: create a product, buy it from a supplier, sell it to a customer, watch stock move, do a manual adjustment, check the history, set up an alert, and take a quick look at Billing and Reports. Let's go!
inventory_tour.step_create_category_desc: Every item needs a category (e.g. "Drinks", "Clothing"). Let's create a practice one - we'll keep the name fixed for this step, and delete it at the end if you don't need it.
inventory_tour.step_create_unit_desc: Same idea as the category: it defines how your product is measured (e.g. "Unit", "Kilogram"). Create a practice one to keep going.
inventory_tour.step_create_product_desc: Fill in name, code, category, unit and prices. Pick the category and unit you just created (or any you already had). This will be your practice product!
inventory_tour.step_why_zero_desc: Notice there's no field for starting stock? That's on purpose: every product is born at 0. That way every unit that comes in is tied to a real purchase, never a number typed by hand - that's what keeps your inventory trustworthy from day one.
inventory_tour.step_create_supplier_desc: To buy stock you first need a supplier. Create a practice one - we'll keep its details fixed for this step, and remove it at the end if you'd like.
inventory_tour.step_create_purchase_desc: Record a purchase using the product you just created and whichever supplier you have available (practice or existing). This is what's going to give your product actual stock.
inventory_tour.step_complete_purchase_desc: When a purchase is completed, the product's stock goes up by exactly the quantity purchased. Find your practice purchase (status "Pending") and complete it.
inventory_tour.step_stock_up_desc: Head to the products table and check your practice product: stock is no longer 0. That's how simple it is for stock to enter your inventory.
inventory_tour.step_create_customer_desc: To sell, you need a customer. Create a practice one to continue.
inventory_tour.step_create_order_desc: Create an order with your practice product and whichever customer you have available. Once completed, stock will drop automatically.
inventory_tour.step_complete_order_desc: Find your practice order in the table and change its status to "Completed" using this selector. Ohnix won't let you sell more than what's available.
inventory_tour.step_stock_down_desc: Back to the products table: your practice product's stock dropped by exactly what you sold. Purchase raises it, sale lowers it - that simple.
inventory_tour.step_adjust_stock_title: What about a physical count or damaged goods?
inventory_tour.step_adjust_stock_desc: That's what manual adjustments are for: use this icon in the products table, on your practice product. It'll always ask for a reason, and it gets recorded just like a purchase or sale.
inventory_tour.step_movement_history_desc: Click this icon on your practice product to see its full history: the purchase, the sale, and any adjustment, all with a date and who did it.
inventory_tour.step_low_stock_alerts_desc: When creating or editing a product you can set your own alert threshold. Once stock falls below that number, the product gets flagged as low and can notify you by email.
inventory_tour.step_billing_intro_desc: Here you can see your current plan, switch plans whenever you need to, and manage your payments.
inventory_tour.step_reports_intro_desc: Here you'll find stock, sales, purchase and top-product reports - all in real time, no need to build them yourself.

demo.title: See Ohnix in action
demo.description: See how Ohnix organizes inventory, purchases, orders, and reports in a single operational experience for SMBs.

hero.title: Inventory, sales, and operations in one place.
hero.subtitle: Ohnix centralizes products, stock, purchases, orders, and reports so your team controls every movement with clarity—without spreadsheets or disconnected tools.

about.title: Built for teams that live by their inventory.
about.description: Ohnix is an operations platform that connects catalog, stock entries, sales, and analytics so small and mid-sized businesses run with fewer errors and faster decisions.

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: Make inventory control simple and reliable.
mission.description: Every product, quantity, and transaction should be easy to register, audit, and act on from a single workspace.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: Operations that scale without losing precision.
vision.description: We want teams to grow volume and complexity while keeping stock accurate and processes consistent.

connected.title: Connected data
connected.description: Purchases, sales, and catalog stay in sync so stock always reflects reality.

sustainable.title: Operational clarity
sustainable.description: Clear states, permissions, and history reduce guesswork across the team.

precise.title: Accurate stock
precise.description: Atomic updates and validations help prevent overselling and silent discrepancies.

solutions.title: Everything you need to run inventory day to day.
solutions.description: Modular tools that work together: configure your catalog, move stock in and out, and measure performance from one dashboard.

lifecycle.title: Products & catalog
lifecycle.description: Manage SKUs, categories, units, prices, and images—including bulk import from CSV.

assets.title: Purchases & stock in
assets.description: Register supplier purchases, track statuses, and increase stock with full traceability.

sustainability.title: Sales & orders
sustainability.description: Create orders, deduct inventory safely, and export professional invoice PDFs.

circular.title: Reports & alerts
circular.description: Monitor sales, purchases, and low-stock signals to decide before problems appear.

timeline.title: From setup to insight in four steps.
timeline.description: A practical flow that matches how teams actually operate: organize the catalog, receive goods, sell, and review results.

observe.title: Organize your catalog
observe.description: Add products, categories, customers, and suppliers—the foundation for accurate stock.

faq.title: Common questions about Ohnix
faq.description: Quick answers about what the platform does and how to get started.

first.question: What is Ohnix?
first.answer: Ohnix is an inventory and operations platform by iTcycle. It helps you manage products, stock, purchases, sales orders, customers, suppliers, and reports from one place.

second.question: Does it support purchases and sales?
second.answer: Yes. You can register purchases to increase stock, create sales orders with safe stock deductions, handle returns where applicable, and generate invoice PDFs.

third.question: Can I import many products at once?
third.answer: Yes. The product module supports bulk upload via CSV so you can migrate or expand your catalog faster.

fourth.question: How do I get started?
fourth.answer: Create an account with the primary button, verify your email, and explore the demo video to see the dashboard, products, and order flows in action.

integrations_page.page_subtitle: Connect your store, generate credentials for your own system, and receive real-time events from Ohnix.

integrations_tour.welcome_desc: This is where you connect Ohnix to your online store, generate credentials for your own system, and set up real-time notifications. Let's walk through each section in 30 seconds.
integrations_tour.api_keys_desc: Generate a key so your own system (a custom-built store, an ERP, a script) can read and update Ohnix products, inventory, and orders directly through the API.
integrations_tour.channels_desc: Connect Shopify or WooCommerce in a couple of clicks: your products get published there, inventory stays in sync, and every sale automatically arrives as an order in Ohnix.
integrations_tour.webhooks_desc: Register your own URL so Ohnix notifies you instantly of events like a new order or an inventory change, instead of you having to keep polling the API.
integrations_tour.finish_desc: You can replay this guide anytime with the "See how it works" button. The full developer documentation lives at /api/v1/docs.

fiscal_setup.privacy_note: Ohnix never keeps your private key or certificate file in the browser. Data is sent once to the encrypted fiscal layer.

fiscal_setup.title: Electronic invoicing
fiscal_setup.subtitle: A guided wizard to get your company ready for DIAN.
fiscal_setup.status_active_hint: You can now issue electronic documents from Ohnix.
fiscal_setup.status_pending_hint: Complete the digital certificate to activate issuance.
fiscal_setup.readiness_unavailable: We couldn't check status with itcycle-api-dian right now
fiscal_setup.readiness_unavailable_hint: This can be momentary (e.g. the service is just waking up). Your company is still registered — try refreshing the status in a few seconds.
fiscal_setup.step_company_caption: Your company's basic tax details for DIAN.
fiscal_setup.step_software_caption: Credentials for your authorized invoicing software.
fiscal_setup.step_address_caption: The fiscal address on file with your RUT.
fiscal_setup.nit_hint: Your tax ID number, without the check digit - Ohnix calculates it automatically.
fiscal_setup.nit_invalid: The tax ID must be 6 to 15 digits, with no dots or dashes.
fiscal_setup.legal_name_hint: Your company's legal name, exactly as it appears on your tax registration.
fiscal_setup.billing_email_hint: Notifications about your invoices and electronic documents will go to this address.
fiscal_setup.vat_responsibility_hint: Whether your company charges VAT on sales - check your tax registration.
fiscal_setup.software_step_assisted_hint: Every company invoices under its own DIAN habilitación (the regulation requires it). Register your company as "own software" in DIAN's portal and paste the ID and PIN they give you here - our team takes care of running the habilitación test set for you.
fiscal_setup.environment_hint: Use "Testing" while you validate your setup. Switch to "Production" only once DIAN has actually enabled your company to invoice.
fiscal_setup.software_id_hint: The ID for your invoicing software, issued by DIAN when they enabled you (a UUID, e.g. deb9167c-e2f6-4796-9b4d-d102472e2397). If you don't have one yet, you need to complete DIAN's enablement process first.
fiscal_setup.software_id_invalid: Must be the UUID DIAN issued you, e.g. deb9167c-e2f6-4796-9b4d-d102472e2397.
fiscal_setup.software_pin_hint: The secret PIN for your invoicing software, issued by DIAN alongside the software ID. Never share it outside your company.
fiscal_setup.technical_key_hint: The technical key DIAN issues alongside the software ID - 40 hexadecimal characters. Used to sign your electronic documents.
fiscal_setup.technical_key_invalid: Must be the 40-character hexadecimal value DIAN issues, e.g. fc8eac422eba16e22ffd8c6f94b3f40a6e38162c.
fiscal_setup.address_hint: Your company's registered physical address, matching your tax registration.
fiscal_setup.city_code_hint: 5 digits - the first two must match the selected department.
fiscal_setup.city_code_mismatch: This code doesn't match the selected department.
fiscal_setup.city_name_hint: The name of the city or municipality where your company operates.
fiscal_setup.department_hint: The department where your company is registered.
fiscal_setup.postal_code_hint: The postal code for your company's registered address.
fiscal_setup.document_type_hint: Choose which document type this numbering enables: sales invoices, or a purchase support document.
fiscal_setup.prefix_hint: The prefix DIAN authorized for numbering your documents (e.g. SETP, max. 4 characters).
fiscal_setup.prefix_invalid: The prefix must be at most 4 characters (letters or numbers).
fiscal_setup.resolution_number_hint: The invoicing resolution number DIAN assigned when they enabled you.
fiscal_setup.number_range_hint: The numbering range DIAN authorized in your resolution.
fiscal_setup.number_range_invalid: The end number must be greater than the start number.
fiscal_setup.validity_dates_hint: The resolution's validity period, as authorized by DIAN.
fiscal_setup.date_range_invalid: The end date must be after the start date.
fiscal_setup.validation_uuid_invalid: Must be the UUID FirmaPass issued for this validation.
fiscal_setup.support_document_hint: Only needed if you buy from suppliers not obligated to invoice - add a "05" numbering resolution, separate from your electronic invoice one.
fiscal_setup.firmapass_hint: Your company controls its key, documents, and validation. Ohnix never displays or keeps them in the browser.
fiscal_setup.firmapass_purchase_title: Your company buys the certificate directly from FirmaPass
fiscal_setup.firmapass_purchase_hint: Ohnix doesn't sell or resell digital certificates - your company buys it directly from FirmaPass, with your own payment method. Pick a duration below, pay with the coupon already applied, and once you have your order number (or the validation's UUID), continue right here.
fiscal_setup.firmapass_ready_hint: Activate invoicing to start issuing from Ohnix.
fiscal_setup.firmapass_activate_missing: Your business isn't ready to invoice yet. Missing: {{items}}.
fiscal_setup.plan_required: Electronic invoicing is available starting on the Negocio plan. Upgrade to continue.
fiscal_setup.firmapass_validation_uuid_placeholder: The UUID created in FirmaPass's portal
fiscal_setup.firmapass_buy_hint: The coupon is already applied in the link - no need to type it in at FirmaPass's checkout.
fiscal_setup.firmapass_order_number_placeholder: The order number FirmaPass gave you at checkout
fiscal_setup.firmapass_personal_data_title: Required step: complete your data on FirmaPass
fiscal_setup.firmapass_personal_data_hint: Before documents can be uploaded or the request confirmed, FirmaPass needs you to review/complete this form on their own portal (name, address, contact info pulled from the RUT). If the steps below fail with "no validation available", this is usually why.
fiscal_setup.firmapass_confirm_success: Request confirmed. FirmaPass will finish issuance asynchronously.
fiscal_setup.firmapass_validation_not_ready_error: FirmaPass says this validation isn't ready for this step. It's very likely the personal-data form on their portal (the "Complete on FirmaPass" button above) still needs to be finished — without that, the validation won't advance even though the RUT was already accepted.
fiscal_setup.firmapass_manual_certificate_title: Already have a digital certificate ready?
fiscal_setup.firmapass_manual_certificate_hint: If you bought it somewhere else, or got it from FirmaPass outside this coupon, upload it here directly as a .p12/.pfx file and carry on as normal — no need to repeat the RUT/document steps.
